description: Aleksandra was a young, strong, confident lady. As a matter of fact, she was so powerful and possessed such willpower that she showed no emotion on the battlefield. This promising student gained the respect of her peers by graduating top of her year. After being welcomed into the elite squads and her first successes in the missions, many hunters believed that Aleksandra was the best warrior in the whole academy, across all generations. Therefore, she was nicknamed "the Apex of the Academy". Unfortunately, a draconian catastrophe struck humanity and reduced the world to ash. Aleksandra was one of the survivors and fought to protect her companions in misfortune. She feared nothing, but without hope, would she be able to build a future?
summon: Even without hope, I will fight for humanity...
fusion: Being the best is not enough to save you, dear sister...
